title: VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility
reasoning: The paper focuses on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in electoral scenarios and how rewriting webpages affects political candidate and party visibility. It measures how different voter personas, including demographic and partisan identities, affect exposure, but it does not evaluate or benchmark faith, religion, morals, or ethics. 'Religiosity' is only used as a demographic variable for clustering voter profiles.
